photo.reason: The photograph shows a group of Igorot men and women performing a traditional dance with drums and gongs, wearing traditional woven garments and loincloths, consistent with documentary photography of Igorot daily/ceremonial life in the Philippines.

photo.name: trumma, män, dans, fotografi, photograph
photo.title: trumma, män, dans, fotografi, photograph
photo.reason: The photo shows Igorot men in traditional loincloth attire performing a dance with a spear-carrying gong/shield, joined by a European visitor (C.E. Nathorst); the setting and dress are consistent with documentary photography of Igorot daily/ceremonial life.

photo.title: Landscape, Farming Area, Terass, Rice Field, Building, Stage Plan, House, Photography, ph
photo.reason: The photo shows the famous Ifugao/Igorot rice terraces of Luzon, a documentary landscape photo of the agricultural work of this cultural region, matching the claimed ethnicity (Ifugao is a subgroup often grouped under Igorot).

photo.name: män, kvinnor, barn, dans, fotografi, photograph
photo.title: män, kvinnor, barn, dans, fotografi, photograph
photo.reason: Documentary photograph of Igorot people (children, women in wraparound skirts) performing a dance, with a Western nun/nurse and colonial-era figures present; genuine ethnographic scene of the group's dress and dance practice.

ceramic.name: kärl, Lerkärl
ceramic.title: kärl, Lerkärl
ceramic.reason: A dark, glossy-slipped earthenware pot with a wide rounded body and everted neck, collected in Banaue, Ifugao (Igorot subgroup), matching traditional Cordillera pottery-making traditions.

sculpture.title: figure

sculpture.title: skulptur, Träskulptur, sculpture
